name: print-social-poster-coral-storytelling-illustration
title: Coral storytelling poster with illustrated desk scene
whatItIs: An A4 poster on a coral-pink background pairing a bold two-tone headline with a flat illustration of a seated figure sketching at a desk and a lightbulb-and-star motif representing ideas.
whatItMeans: Placing an idea/lightbulb icon opposite a working illustrated figure visually narrates the creative process itself (idea → execution) within a single static poster.
techniques: split a headline across two font weights/colors for emphasis without extra elements
use a lightbulb-with-rays motif as visual shorthand for 'ideas'
balance an icon zone and an illustration zone side-by-side rather than stacking them

vocabulary.definition: a simplified, widely recognized symbol used to instantly communicate a concept (e.g. lightbulb = idea)
